question: Can isolated AI reviewers, without access to YOLO, segmentation, fusion, scheduler, or prior event-effect outputs, produce a stable and exhaustive parent-natural-event ledger for visible central-image obstruction from a frozen continuous-RGB universe?
non_goals: running YOLO, SegFormer, DDRNet, depth, anomaly segmentation, or any other candidate model
selecting a topology operator, free-space threshold, category remapping, or fusion rule
estimating intended route, user motion intent, real traversability, collision risk, or safety
changing Android, A568, the default model, risk, event, feedback, or production behavior
granting D0-B execution, Confirmation, Deployment, product, or real-user authority

data_partitions.identity_basis: D0-A0 must enumerate complete source/session identities, continuous frame ranges, timestamps, ancestry, frame hashes, and session groups before D0-A2.
data_partitions.reuse_policy: CANARY_AGENT_LABEL_READINESS_ONLY; disclose prior content or algorithm-output access per session; never infer unseen Confirmation status.

observation_contract.roi_semantics: A frozen image-space region only; not intended route, body heading, future trajectory, free space, or a safety corridor.
observation_contract.parent_event_rule: Consecutive observations belonging to one natural obstruction or one continuous not-evaluable episode form one parent event. Frames and derived windows are longitudinal repeats, never independent event samples.

agent_review_workflow.agreement_route: Matching labels and event boundaries form model consensus under the frozen matching rule.
agent_review_workflow.disagreement_route: A third fresh Agent first labels the same frozen evidence independently, then receives the two hash-bound reviews for adjudication.
agent_review_workflow.unresolved_route: Quarantine only the affected item as NOT_EVALUABLE; do not create or wait on a human task.

phase_plan.name: INPUT_UNIVERSE_FREEZE
phase_plan.output: Immutable source/session/frame/timestamp/ancestry manifest and SHA-256 receipt.

phase_plan.name: EXCLUDED_CALIBRATION_PILOT
phase_plan.output: Excluded calibration bundle, frozen prompt, ROI, event-boundary/matching rule, readiness thresholds, and prompt/input hashes.

phase_plan.name: INDEPENDENT_AGENT_LABEL_PASSES
phase_plan.output: Two immutable isolated review ledgers over the full admitted continuous-RGB universe.

phase_plan.name: CONSENSUS_AND_ADJUDICATION
phase_plan.output: Hash-bound consensus/adjudication receipts plus a derived canonical ledger that never overwrites raw reviews.

phase_plan.name: EVENT_LEVEL_READINESS_AUDIT
phase_plan.output: Parent-event agreement, source/session coverage, label distribution, adjudication burden, NOT_EVALUABLE burden, limitations, and one terminal.

artifact_contract.immutability: Raw reviewer and adjudicator outputs are append-only evidence. The canonical ledger is derived and cannot overwrite them.

constraints.description: No reviewer, adjudicator, event generator, readiness evaluator, or calibration pass may read YOLO, segmentation, depth, fusion, scheduler, risk, feedback, or prior candidate-effect output.

Complete source/session/frame ranges and their hashes must be frozen before any production label pass; easy segments cannot be added and difficult segments cannot be shortened or removed after inspection.
Annotation, review, adjudication, and readiness acceptance are autonomous. No human-required queue, fallback, or pending gate may be created.
Every isolated review and adjudication is hash-bound and retained; consensus derivation cannot overwrite or silently repair raw labels or boundaries.
Parent natural events are the analysis units. Frames, overlapping windows, and multiple observations from one parent event remain grouped longitudinal repeats.
The protocol may state only no visible central obstruction evidence; it cannot emit CLEAR, SAFE, FREE_SPACE, TRAVERSABLE, UNKNOWN_OBSTACLE, or equivalent real-world claims.
D0-A1 calibration items cannot contribute to D0-A4 readiness counts or agreement. The final matching rule and numeric readiness thresholds must be frozen before D0-A2.
Unresolved review or event-boundary disagreement becomes NOT_EVALUABLE for the affected item; it cannot be converted into a forced positive or negative label.

freeze.lock_transition: After D0-A1 freezes the admitted manifest, prompts, matching rule, and numeric readiness thresholds, any production-label change requires a new protocol version.

READY_FOR_D0_B_AGENT_LABELED_DEVELOPMENT.meaning: The frozen Agent workflow produced a sufficiently stable and covered model-adjudicated observation ledger under the D0-A1 lock.

HOLD_DATA.meaning: The admitted continuous-RGB universe lacks sufficient scoreable parent events, source/session coverage, or required scene/quality coverage.

AGENT_LABEL_PROTOCOL_NOT_RELIABLE.meaning: The observable, event-boundary, matching, agreement, adjudication, or abstention process is not stable enough for D0-B.

successor_policy.pass_successor: A separate reviewed D0-B design may freeze one model B, one category mapping, one primary obstruction operator, and the A versus C event-level estimand.
successor_policy.hold_successor: Retain the immutable inventory and labelability diagnosis; acquire or reclassify evidence only under a new bounded source plan.
successor_policy.unreliable_successor: Revise the observation definition or Agent workflow in a new version; do not run model B against unstable labels.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Freeze one continuous-RGB universe and one excluded calibration set, then run two isolated full-universe label passes with fresh third-Agent adjudication only where the frozen agreement rule requires it.
experiment_design.resource_budget: Existing continuous RGB only; bounded Agent review and local hash/receipt validation; no detector, segmentation, Android, device, network-model, or training execution.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop at the first valid D0-A terminal. Do not run model B, select a topology feature, or extend the admitted input universe after production review starts.
experiment_design.efficiency_strategy: Reuse the project AI-review interface and validator; quarantine only disputed items; preserve all raw ledgers while keeping the canonical current conclusion in one entry.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Central-image visible obstruction is a narrower observable than intended-route traversability and can be reviewed from frozen RGB without candidate-model output.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Separates whether the observation can be defined reliably from whether any segmentation model later adds event-level information to YOLO.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Determines whether a D0-B model-increment experiment has a stable Agent-adjudicated event denominator or should stop before model search.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Two isolated Agent passes plus hash-bound third-Agent adjudication under one frozen event matching rule.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Parent-event agreement, source/session and event-type coverage, adjudication burden, and NOT_EVALUABLE burden under D0-A1 thresholds.
hypotheses.falsifier: The frozen workflow cannot produce stable parent-event labels/boundaries or adequate cross-session scoreable coverage without candidate-output access.
hypotheses.resource_budget: Existing continuous RGB, three isolated Agent roles when needed, and local validation only.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Return HOLD_DATA or AGENT_LABEL_PROTOCOL_NOT_RELIABLE and do not run D0-B.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It is the cheapest direct test of whether the proposed heterogeneous double-loop question is answerable before selecting or deploying a second model.

failure_learning.observation: No D0-A input manifest, calibration, production review, adjudication, or readiness audit has run under this protocol.
alternative_explanations: The current source universe may lack visible central-obstruction diversity.
The ROI or event-boundary definition may be intrinsically ambiguous under head turns, blur, darkness, or occlusion.
Agent reviewers may share correlated visual priors despite context isolation.
reuse_candidates: The frozen input inventory can remain a source-characterization asset.
Disagreement and NOT_EVALUABLE episodes can become future stress cases.
The review prompts and receipts can remain regression fixtures.

claim_ceiling: MODEL_ADJUDICATED_OBSERVATION_LABELS / CANARY_ONLY. A READY terminal means only that a D0-B Development design is answerable. It is not human ground truth, objective sensor truth, model increment, traversability, real-user effect, safety, product, or deployment evidence.
